Answer: B
Reason: The serial chest X-rays (Figures 1a, 3a, 4a, 6a) demonstrate a clear progression from initial nodular densities in the middle and lower lung fields to widespread, diffuse bilateral infiltrative lesions with areas of radiolucency, consistent with advanced bronchioloalveolar carcinoma. Options suggesting stability, regression, or isolated upper lobe involvement contradict the visible worsening of the disease over time.
